content: Wilson score lower bound: sort by lower bound of binomial confidence interval on (upvotes/(upvotes+downvotes)) rather than raw ratio or raw count. Prevents a 1/1 (100%) item from outranking a 999/1000 (99.9%) item -- the interval widens with small n, pulling the lower bound down. Formula: (phat + z^2/2n - z*sqrt((phat(1-phat)+z^2/4n)/n)) / (1+z^2/n). Standard technique for small-sample ranking noise, per Evan Miller.
